ACT X OF 2006
PUNJAB
CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2006
An Act further to amend the Punjab Civil
Servants Act, 1974
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, dated 17th October, 2006]
No.PAP-Legis-2(41)/2006/869, dated 17-10-2006.---The
Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Bill 2006, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 2nd October, 2006, and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on 12th October, 2006, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 (VIII of
1974), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act
may be called the Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
